name: parallel_batch
why: Calls that can go together share one round. A later round may be its own batch. These two lookups are not one call each.
inbound: What's on my calendar today, and what was last night's sleep score?

tools.name: google__calendar_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events for a day. Args: date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today).

tools.name: garmin__sleep_summary
tools.description: Last night's sleep. No args. Returns score and hours.
